name: hud_weather_fx_reset_particle_slot
description: HudWeatherFx::ResetParticleSlot respawns one particle into the weather cone and mirrors the source position into the destination buffer.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudWeatherFx class pass.
Binary Ninja has x87 flag-lifting warnings around the cone reflection comparisons; assembly was used as the behavior source.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bdee0 validates selecting source/destination zVec3 buffers by sourceBufferIndex/destBufferIndex, generating z/x/y from rand-scaled ranges, reflecting x or y when the value is below -z by adding 1.5 and replacing z with 1.5-z, copying source into destination, and callee-cleaning two stack arguments.
The native HudWeatherFx constructor smoke verifies reset-initialized particles are copied to both buffers and stay inside the BN-observed z range.
